description: Diagnose the current or a named agent session of Claude Code, Codex, or Copilot CLI -- in general or for a particular issue hint -- by reading its on-disk transcript read-only, triaging it along several diagnosis dimensions in parallel, and reporting severity-tagged, `path:line`-cited findings with likely root causes and recommendations. Use when the user wants to know "what went wrong", "why it took so long", "why it is so expensive", or why a skill did not fire, or wants a session "diagnosed" or "investigated".
